title: Tamil Nadu industrial-incentive expenditure, verified actuals
boundary_note: Direct cash incentives to industrial units under Demand No. 27 (major head 2852): investment promotion subsidy, structured package of assistance, capital/ETP/training subsidies and land-cost incentives, largely disbursed through SIPCOT. Excludes electricity-tariff subsidies (Energy Department), the economic value of concessional SIPCOT land prices, PSU capital support, and departmental establishment costs. Budget provisions systematically exceed actual disbursement for these heads; only audited actuals and the department's own disbursement statements are used here.

cumulative_structured_package.source: Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce Department, Policy Note 2024-25, p. 67

method_note: Years shown are those whose CAG Appropriation Accounts were retrieved and line-checked. The 2011-12 accounts show the analogous heads budgeted at Rs 1,125 crore and disbursing nil, so the series should not be interpolated. Per-policy attribution of spending is not published anywhere; the structured-package cumulative spans both the 2007-2014 and 2014-2021 policy regimes.
